name: Moo ping
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai grilled pork skewers (1.5 lb pork tenderloin, 10 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp each of thin soy and oyster sauce, 1.5 tbsp palm sugar, 1 tsp sugar, 1 cup whole milk for 4): per 100 g of cooked pork about a seventh of that marinade is eaten. Vendors use fattier neck; the page uses tenderloin and so does the recipe. Grilling takes about 10 percent of the weight.
